import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from view import View

def test_basic_begin_finish():
    v = View()
    r1 = v.begin("q1")
    assert r1 == 1
    assert v.loading == True
    assert v.error is None
    result = v.finish(r1, [[1, 2], [3, 4]])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    assert v.loading == False

def test_monotonically_increasing_id():
    v = View()
    r1 = v.begin("q1")
    r2 = v.begin("q2")
    r3 = v.begin("q3")
    assert r1 < r2 < r3

def test_old_request_id_returns_false():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    r1 = v.begin("q1")  # seq=1
    r2 = v.begin("q2")  # seq=2
    result = v.finish(r1, [[1]])  # r1=1 is stale
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == []
    result = v.finish(r2, [[2]])  # r2=2 is current
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == [[2]]

def test_duplicate_request_id_returns_false():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    r = v.begin("q1")
    result1 = v.finish(r, [[1]])
    assert result1 == True
    result2 = v.finish(r, [[2]])  # duplicate id
    assert result2 == False
    assert v.rows == [[1]]

def test_begin_clears_error_keeps_rows():
    v = View()
    v.finish(999, [[old]])  # simulate old rows
    result = v.finish(999, [[old]])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == [[old]]
    result = v.finish(999, [[new]])
    assert result == False  # stale id
    assert v.rows == [[old]]  # rows preserved
    
    v.begin("q1")  # clear error
    assert v.error is None

def test_loading_exposed():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading == False
    v.begin("q1")
    assert v.loading == True
    v.finish(1, [[1]])
    assert v.loading == False

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.notes["job1"] = "note1"
    v.finish(1, [[1]])
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note1"
    
    v.begin("q2")
    v.notes["job2"] = "note2"
    v.finish(2, [[2]])
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note1"
    assert v.notes["job2"] == "note2"

def test_copy_accepted_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, [[1], [2]])
    rows = v.rows
    rows.append([3])  # modify copy
    assert v.rows == [[1], [2]]

def test_finish_after_begin_requires_matching_id():
    v = View()
    r = v.begin("q1")
    # Try to finish with wrong id
    result = v.finish(r + 1, [[wrong]])
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == []

def test_finish_with_none_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    result = v.finish(1, None)
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows is None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_basic_begin_finish()
    test_monotonically_increasing_id()
    test_old_request_id_returns_false()
    test_duplicate_request_id_returns_false()
    test_begin_clears_error_keeps_rows()
    test_loading_exposed()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_copy_accepted_rows()
    test_finish_after_begin_requires_matching_id()
    test_finish_with_none_rows()
    print("All tests passed!")
